scope: Reconstruct the preserved descriptive product-return study from this run's fresh imports. Independent of primary rebalancing policy; no portfolio/accounting change.

interpretation.long: Five unlevered product NAVs; no simulated investor costs or borrowing.
interpretation.short: Six-product common overlap plus identical five-product window. Amundi daily-reset 2x exposure differs from unlevered NAVs and main 1.25x band-managed debt.
interpretation.monthly: Last common observed valuation per month; final partial August 2026 omitted. October 2014 month-end is the initial level.
interpretation.negative: Core return strictly negative; selected irregular intervals, not a continuous wealth path or future protection guarantee.
interpretation.rolling: 252 common valuation intervals. Overlapping descriptive windows, no probability/causality interpretation.
interpretation.calibration_confirmation: Recalculate returns within each level panel; first confirmation return ends 5 January 2022, excluding the interval into its opening level.
interpretation.limitations: Published unchanged NAVs/ties retained. Co-movement does not establish holdings overlap, independent factor premiums or future diversification protection. Not forecasts or investment advice.
